summary: No high-confidence, diff-caused standards findings. The workflow, dependency lock, validator boundary, and mutation tests align with the stated repository policy.
positive_changes: The official SPDX gate precedes repository-contract validation and artifact upload.
CI and release installation enforce hashes and binary-only packages.
Mutation tests cover lock drift, installation weakening, validator bypass and ordering, and invalid SPDX fixtures.
testing_recommendations: For lock updates, verify the complete Linux and Python 3.12 resolution with hash enforcement and binary-only installation.
Use the first complete release lifecycle as an operational acceptance test.
